sections.A: Coronary artery disease mein dil ki muscle ko khoon dene wali naliyan tang hoti hain. Heart attack, stent (PCI) ya bypass (CABG) ke baad cardiac rehab hota hai.
sections.B: Badalne wale risk factors: smoking, BP, cholesterol, diabetes, motapa aur kam activity. Rehab in sab par kaam karta hai.
sections.C: Kya hua, kab, kaun sa ilaaj, complications aur ejection fraction; aur abhi seene ka dard ya saans ki takleef.
sections.D: Aaraam mein dhadkan, BP, SpO2, rhythm aur zakhm (seene ki haddi, taang ka graft).
sections.E: Patients ko kam, darmiyana ya zyada risk mein baanta jata hai: exercise capacity, ejection fraction aur symptoms dekh kar.
sections.G: Aaraam mein seene ka dard ya jo aaraam aur GTN se na jaye: emergency.
sections.H: Medically stable aur clear hai? Phase I hospital mein dheere dheere chalna, Phase II supervised exercise, Phase III lambi activity.
sections.I: CABG ke baad seene ki haddi ki ehtiyat; ab bohat se centers sakht pabandiyon ke bajaye dard aur ehsaas ke mutabiq ehtiyat rakhte hain.
sections.J: Phase II: 10-15 minute warm-up, phir aerobic exercise RPE ya dhadkan ke mutabiq, taaqat ki exercise, aur cool-down.
sections.K: Machines nahi; pedometer aur heart rate monitor adherence mein madad karte hain.
sections.L: Lambe arse ka goal: hafte mein kam az kam 150 minute darmiyani activity aur taaqat ki exercise.
sections.M: 6MWT ya METs, risk factors, zindagi ka mayar, aur pareshani ya depression dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 58 saal ke aadmi ko 3 hafte pehle heart attack ke baad stent laga. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
